transitions.reason: Controller-only fix: treat unsupported payloads as blocked before task signatures; show failed-worker log tails; retain the original bank seal when resuming this audited transition. No adapter, registry, payload, image processing, matching, seed or checkpoint changes.

Includes the audited queue-controller fix, plus initialization-only fixes for FNNS (freeze TorchScript parameters individually) and DistSeal (strict VideoWam state loading excluding only the unused training autoencoder.model.* subtree). These two models must have no previous model identity, PNGs or image records at first migration. Other adapter classes, registry, payloads, scalar matching, seeds and selected checkpoints are unchanged; preserve the original bank seal and record this transition separately.
